messages:
support_jane: FYI — ACME corp reported a spike in 429s after we merged 'incremental-throttle-v2' into main at 2026-03-17T17:40Z. Ticket https://redwood/t/12345. Quick log sample: {"status":429,"route":"/v1/generate","policy":"inc-throttle-v2","client":"acme-api"}. Can eng-platform advise rollback or tuning? cc @kevin-eng @maria-sre

kevin-eng: Thanks. I see the canary passed but traffic was skewed — we merged at an 80% window. Can you paste full last-10m percentiles from telemetry? Also did we apply region overrides?

support_jane: Paste from metrics (last 10m): p50=120ms, p95=400ms, 429-rate=3.2% (normal<0.5%). Region: us-west default, but ACME traffic is mostly us-east. Policy merge had no per-region exception.

maria-sre: 3.2% 429s is concerning. Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback merge (fast) 2) add temporary per-client override to raise limit for ACME 3) widen canary to 95% so it's only affecting a smaller subset — but currently it's already merged. Suggest rollback + investigate root cause.

tom-platform: We can rollback with the admin CLI: `rwctl policy rollback incremental-throttle-v2 --to incremental-throttle-v1 --reason "customer-429s" --force` Will take ~60s to propagate. Anyone object?

support_jane: Do it. Also request to create a temp rule to exclude ACME for 2 hours: `rwctl policy add-exception --client acme-api --policy incremental-throttle-v2 --limit 10rps` — will that conflict?

kevin-eng: Rollback first so we stop 429 bleed. After rollback, add exception if needed. Tom, please run rollback and post command output.

tom-platform: Running now. Output: `OK: policy incremental-throttle-v2 -> incremental-throttle-v1 (activated)` Propagating to edge in ~45s. Monitoring metrics.

sre-oncall-bot: Deploy event: policy-rollback by tom-platform at 2026-03-17T17:43:06Z. Observability alert channel linked.

maria-sre: Early telemetry after rollback (30s): 429-rate down to 0.4%, p95 back to 210ms. Good. Next actions: collect request samples (ids), run regression test comparing token trimming, and open postmortem. Assign leads: Kevin for policy tuning, Tom for rollout automation, Support Jane for customer comms.

support_jane: Noted. I'll tell ACME we rolled back and are investigating. ETA for follow-up 2 hours. :thumbsup: 

kevin-eng: For postmortem, let's store the canary config used: `canary_percent=80`, `staging_duration=10m`, `region_override=null`, `per_client_exceptions=[]`. Also we should add a pre-merge perf smoke test against a synthetic ACME workload.
